routes.firstScreen: Progress What you have recorded, and what to do about it Self-reported skill levels, roadmap statuses, logged hours and bookmarks. All of it is editable, exportable and erasable. Skills rated 0 0 confident Tasks completed 0 of 0 tracked Hours logged 0 h Your own entries Bookmarks 0 Across all types Self-rated skills what the planner sees No skills rated yet Rating skills takes a minute and makes every recommendation in the app specific to you. Run a gap analysis Task progress from your roadmaps No roadmap progress yet Statuses you set on roadmap tasks appear here. Open your roadmap Bookmarks skills, projects and resources you saved Nothing bookmarked. Use the save button on a skill, project or resource to keep it here. Nothing here is shared or ranked There are no leaderboards, no study streaks and no comparison with other people. Progress exists so the planner can schedule realistically
